Author: NearVoice contributors; original by Ricimon
Name: NearVoice
Description: Automatic world/map proximity, quiet connection/map changes, bounded audio buffers, Turkish font and optional talking animation. 0.2.2 disables old default join/leave beeps once while preserving microphone and other settings. /yakin opens the panel.

Author: XeldarAlz; local Discord adaptation
Name: Aethr App (local Discord)
Punchline: Your existing phone interface with your Discord friends.
Description: Private local edition based on Aetherphone. Uses official Discord authorization for contacts and text chat. Aethernet services and unchecked native media/browser playback are disabled.

Author: YF
Name: Musical Guide (local camera R10)
Description: R10: mounted first-person follows the rider's animated head through the native attachment world transform, with coordinated local head masking. Existing near-clipping, on-foot head tracking, offsets/FOV and seat profiles retained. Unknown/unready attachment data keeps the original camera. Actual mount visual acceptance pending. Use /mguide.
Punchline: Enhanced camera distance control and first-person experience.

Author: Risa and Contributors
Name: Customize+ (local NearFace fork)
Punchline: Customize your character beyond FFXIV's limitations.
Description: Local NearFace fork: profile-preserving facial overlays, measured eyelid opt-in and independent native Character-view mirror overlay. Cooperative local first-person head masking now supports a verified mounted rider eye. Not an official Aether Tools release. Visual sculpt acceptance required.

Author: NearFace contributors
Name: NearFace (face, mirror + head tracking)
Description: Explicit-start local webcam face/head tracking. /nearface mirror opens a native character-face view without moving the gameplay camera. 16 approximate channels include lip width/narrowing; response and component preferences are saved. Matching Customize+ 2.2.1.7 required. Tongue, cheek puff, nose and precise gaze are unavailable. No other-player synchronization. Native mirror/render acceptance pending.
Punchline: Local face controls and read-only bone inventory for the matching C+ fork.
